channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula e Trump se cumprimentam em evento social, mas sem debater tarifas
item.description: Lula and Trump exchanged greetings at a social event during the G7 summit in Évian-les-Bains, France, on the evening of June 16, 2026, but did not discuss tariffs. Despite the greeting, Trump had previously ignored Lula during the official summit photo, fueling speculation about bilateral tensions. The meeting took place amid rising trade disputes, after the U.S. proposed new tariffs on Brazilian goods, citing unfair trade practices.

item.title: Pesquisas eleitorais: a disputa Lula x Flávio após últimos números e o novo Datafolha
item.description: Recent CNT/MDA and BTG/Nexus polls show Lula expanding his lead over Flávio Bolsonaro, with 49.3% to 36.8% in the CNT/MDA second-round scenario (a 12.5-point gap) and 49% to 43% in the BTG/Nexus poll. The upcoming Datafolha survey, fielded March 17–19 with 2,004 interviews, will test whether this trend holds, also measuring vote intentions, government approval, economic and security perceptions, and potential impact of Donald Trump’s endorsement.

item.title: Lula e Trump se cumprimentam durante evento social do G7
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and U.S. President Donald Trump exchanged greetings during a social event at the G7 summit in France, following a concert hosted by Emmanuel Macron. Although they were in close proximity during the 'family photo' of the summit, they did not interact at that time. Lula’s aides confirmed the greeting was not captured on photo or video, and no formal bilateral meeting was requested by either side.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro vive em mundo paralelo e se consolida como ‘camisa 10’ da campanha de Lula
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro's STF conviction for coercing ministers unintentionally boosted Lula's campaign by linking his name to U.S. sanctions threats against Brazil, damaging Bolsonaro's image. His absence from the U.S. and Flávio Bolsonaro's meetings with Donald Trump are alienating independent voters, while Bolsonaro allies consider replacing him with Rogério Marinho for the 2026 race amid declining polls and fears of new scandals.

item.title: Uma arquitetura institucional para a soberania digital brasileira
item.description: Brazil, under the Lula government, has advanced its digital sovereignty agenda but still lacks a permanent institutional architecture to sustain it. Reliance on direct presidential action makes the policy fragile and vulnerable to government changes. A centralized body, like the UK’s DSIT, is needed to integrate dispersed competencies across ministries and ensure continuity, decision-making power, and coherence in governing digital infrastructure, data, semiconductors, and AI.

item.title: Em pré-campanha, André do Prado congela pauta da Alesp há três semanas
item.description: André do Prado, president of Alesp and Senate pre-candidate, has suspended the leaders' college meetings for three weeks, halting the state legislative agenda. The only vote expected before the recess is the 2026 LDO, while other bills, such as the teacher career restructuring, are postponed until after the election. His agenda has been dominated by political alignments with Tarcísio de Freitas and pre-campaign events, drawing criticism from legislators for neglecting his legislative duties.

item.title: Dino desautoriza TSE e reafirma decisão que impede candidatura de Arthur Henrique em RR
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino reaffirmed the decision blocking Arthur Henrique’s (PL) candidacy for governor of Roraima, upholding the requirement for public officials to resign three to six months before the June 21 supplementary election. He emphasized that the TSE’s administrative process cannot override the STF’s constitutional authority and that the ruling remains 'full and current,' regardless of the pending vote by Justice Cármen Lúcia. The decision follows the TRE-RR’s prior denial of Arthur Henrique’s candidacy registration.

item.title: Focos de Lula e Flávio, partidos do Centrão tendem a liberar filiados
item.description: Centrão parties are leaning toward releasing members to support presidential candidates based on state preferences, without formalizing national alliances until July-August conventions. Lula sought to attract the bloc to expand his campaign’s reach, including negotiations with MDB for a vice-presidential slot, but the party shows a tendency toward neutrality. Flávio Bolsonaro pursued alliances with PP and União Brasil, but investigations into Banco Master and Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP) have caused a rift, undermining the talks.

item.title: Sem trégua institucional
item.description: The unanimous condemnation of Eduardo Bolsonaro by the First Chamber of the STF and the defensive speech by Davi Alcolumbre, president of Congress, amid accusations of receiving money from Daniel Vorcaro, reveal the depth of Brazil's institutional crisis. Though isolated events, both expose a pattern of confrontation between branches of government and a lack of truce in the political arena, indicating the country remains in a prolonged state of institutional tension.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro condenado por coação de Justiça - O Assunto #1741
item.description: The Brazilian Supreme Court (STF) unanimously convicted former federal deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro of obstruction of justice, sentencing him to 4 years and 2 months in prison and 12 years of political ineligibility for attempting to pressure the U.S. government into imposing sanctions on Brazil to benefit his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, in the 2022 coup plot trial. The ruling, led by Minister Alexandre de Moraes and supported by Cristiano Zanin, Cármen Lúcia and Flávio Dino, underscores a coordinated effort to undermine Brazil’s judiciary through foreign influence.

item.title: Lo que la izquierda aún tiene que entender
item.description: The passage describes how part of the poor population supports Flávio Bolsonaro, son of Jair Bolsonaro and Lula’s main opponent, despite his father’s imprisonment for attempted coup. Despite material improvements under PT governments, many poor Brazilians align with the far right, revealing a political dilemma across Latin America. The market scene symbolizes the disconnect between socioeconomic gains and political loyalty, especially among the most vulnerable.

item.title: Lula insiste no erro de bloquear recursos de agências reguladoras
item.description: The Lula government announced a new 20% budget cut for 11 regulatory agencies and the ANPD, claiming it offsets R$14.1 billion in increased spending on the Continuous Benefit Program (BPC) and R$11 billion in Social Security expenditures. The cuts impact strategic sectors including energy, mining, oil and gas, health surveillance, and telecommunications, amid agency budgets now lower than a decade ago. The measure is criticized as a consequence of fiscal mismanagement and undermines oversight in essential areas.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1: definição sobre PEC deve ficar para julho, diz presidente da CCJ do Senado
item.description: Otto Alencar, president of the Senate’s CCJ, said the decision on how to proceed with the PEC ending the 6x1 work scale will be postponed until the first half of July, disappointing the government’s hope to approve it before the parliamentary recess. The proposal has not yet been forwarded by Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, who is waiting for a conversation with Lula before moving forward, following their estrangement after the rejection of Jorge Messias’ STF nomination.

item.title: Rivais nas urnas há dois anos, Tabata e Boulos têm pesos distintos na pré-campanha de Haddad ao governo de SP
item.description: Haddad assigns distinct roles to Tabata Amaral and Guilherme Boulos in his pre-campaign for São Paulo governor: Tabata was consulted to contribute to the government plan, especially on public security, while Boulos, despite being a minister and ally, will not have a direct role due to his agenda in Brasília, although he pledges to support on the ticket and through social movements.

item.title: No G7, Lula se reúne hoje com big techs para discutir inteligência artificial
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will attend a lunch at the G7 summit with CEOs from major tech companies including Meta, Google, OpenAI, and Mistral IA to discuss artificial intelligence regulation. The meeting highlights a divide between European nations, which favor stricter AI rules, and the U.S., which prefers minimal restrictions on technological development. Lula will also address global inequalities, criticizing protectionism and advocating for international cooperation to reduce debt burdens on developing countries.

item.title: Caso Master no Supremo: decisão da Segunda turma escancara tensão
item.description: The Second Chamber of the STF upheld the imprisonment of Henrique Vorcaro, father of former banker Daniel Vorcaro, in a decision that exposed internal tensions within the court. Relator Minister André Mendonça signaled that the Master Case investigations continue and that there are attempts to weaken them, while Minister Kassio Nunes Marques was seen as a central figure, following Mendonça’s vote. The session served as a portrait of the silent polarization in the STF regarding the case, with more exposed positions and a 'cold war' atmosphere.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro produziu e divulgou provas que o condenaram
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro shared a video on social media showing him firing three types of weapons — a pistol, a rifle, and a machine gun — at a U.S. shooting range, wearing a cap and t-shirt, seemingly unfazed by an upcoming trial in Brazil. The content was labeled as exclusive subscriber material, requiring registration for full access.

item.title: Dino diz que regras do STF para Roraima valem mesmo com análise do TSE
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino ruled that Roraima's Regional Electoral Court must follow his desincompatibilization rules (3, 4, or 6 months), even as the case is under review at the TSE, favoring interim governor Soldado Sampaio (Republicanos) and disqualifying Arthur Henrique (PL-RR). The decision was upheld by the STF’s 1st Chamber, which affirmed the Court’s role as the final authority on constitutional interpretation.

item.title: TSE inicia julgamento sobre suposta fraude à cota de gênero nas Eleições 2022 no Amapá
item.description: The TSE began judging allegations of gender quota fraud in the 2022 Amapá elections, involving Podemos' candidacies for state deputy. Relator Minister André Mendonça voted to recognize the fraud, citing low vote totals, lack of campaign bank accounts, and absence of effective campaign activities. Minister Dias Toffoli requested a view, and the trial will resume next Tuesday (23).

item.title: CLDF concede título de Cidadão Honorário de Brasília a Nunes Marques
item.description: The Legislative Chamber of the Federal District awarded the title of Honorary Citizen of Brasília to Supreme Court Justice Kassio Nunes Marques, also president of the Superior Electoral Court, in recognition of his legal trajectory and institutional contributions. The bill, introduced by deputy Eduardo Pedrosa (União), emphasized his commitment to the Constitution and democratic strengthening. Other STF ministers, including Cristiano Zanin and Gilmar Mendes, have previously received the same honor.

item.title: Lula, que critica Flávio, já disse que facções devem ser combatidas como terrorismo
item.description: President Lula (PT), despite criticizing the U.S. decision to formally classify Brazilian criminal factions as terrorists and using it to attack rival Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), had previously advocated treating actions by the Red Command (CV) as terrorism and combating them accordingly.

item.title: 'Porta-vozes do Lula' ultrapassam 50 mil inscritos em 5 dias e PT quer chegar a meio milhão
item.description: The PT celebrated reaching over 50,000 volunteers enrolled as 'spokespersons' for President Lula on social media in just five days, calling it an unprecedented feat. These supporters will act to counter disinformation and bolster the government against Bolsonaro's online influence. The party aims to reach half a million enrolled volunteers by the 2026 elections.

item.title: Apreensão de arma de Bolsonaro reduz chance de Moraes prorrogar prisão domiciliar
item.description: The seizure of a firearm registered in the name of former President Jair Bolsonaro during a traffic stop in Brasília reduces the likelihood that Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes will extend Bolsonaro’s house arrest, which is set to expire on June 25. Although the custody had been compliant without incident, the gun seizure weighs against a potential 90-day extension.

item.title: Caiado diz que transição após fim da escala 6 X 1 deve ser maior
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD-GO), a pre-candidate for the presidency, argued that the transition to ending the 6x1 work schedule must be gradual and account for sectoral and regional differences, warning that rapid changes could harm sectors dependent on specialized labor, such as healthcare and electrical maintenance. He rejected short-term implementation proposals, stating such changes require long-term planning to avoid disrespect and operational difficulties.

item.title: Flávio chama condenação de Eduardo de vingança, e petistas falam em traição da pátria
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro labeled the STF's conviction of his brother, Eduardo Bolsonaro, as an act of political revenge. Petistas claimed the decision constitutes a betrayal of the homeland, intensifying polarization ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: CNT: 42% dizem votar em Lula, mas só 21% se veem como de esquerda
item.description: The CNT opinion poll released on June 16, 2026, shows President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva leading the first round with 41.8% of voting intentions, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro with 28.2%. Although Lula reaches 49.3% in the simulated runoff, only 21.3% of respondents identify as left-wing, indicating a gap between candidate support and self-identified political ideology.

item.title: Solidariedade pede que TSE suspenda eleições em Roraima
item.description: Solidariedade and the Renovação Solidária-RR Federation requested the TSE to suspend the supplementary gubernatorial and vice-gubernatorial election in Roraima, scheduled for June 21, 2026, citing severe rains that isolated communities, blocked roads, and disrupted electoral logistics. The petition was assigned to Minister Floriano de Azevedo Marques Neto, and no interim decision had been issued at the time of publication. The dispute resulted in a single-candidate race, with interim Governor Soldado Sampaio (Republicanos) as the sole contender, following a STF ruling by Minister Flávio Dino that enforced a 6-month disaffiliation rule, disqualifying other potential candidates.

item.title: Lula não se reúne com Trump no G7, mas manda recados ao americano
item.description: President Lula did not meet with Trump at the G7 but used his speech to indirectly criticize U.S. unilateral and protectionist trade policies, particularly the threat of 25% tariffs on Brazilian goods, and defended national sovereignty in response to the U.S. designation of PCC and Comando Vermelho as terrorist organizations. Although a bilateral meeting was anticipated, none occurred, and any progress in trade negotiations remains uncertain.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro diz que levará decisão do STF a Trump
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro said he will inform the U.S. government, including President Trump and authorities at the Department of Justice and Congress, about the STF decision that convicted him for attempting to interfere in the trial of former President Jair Bolsonaro. He questioned whether only Brazil is correct in the case and advocated for changing the national political landscape to confront what he calls a 'persecutor STF'.

item.title: Justiça determina suspensão de campanha do governo Lula sobre fim da 6x1
item.description: The Federal District Court ordered a 48-hour suspension of paid social media campaigns by the Lula government regarding the end of the 6x1 work schedule, partially granting a popular action filed by federal deputy Carlos Jordy (PL-RJ). The ruling aims to prevent the use of public funds for political promotion amid the national debate on working hours.

item.title: PL vê “perseguição” após condenação de Eduardo Bolsonaro
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro was sentenced to 4 years and 2 months in semi-open regime for coercion in the course of judicial proceedings, for attempting to influence the trial of former President Jair Bolsonaro at the STF. Congress members and his family denounced the ruling as political persecution, accusing the judiciary of bias and instrumentalizing institutions against the opposition.

item.title: Votação na Câmara de projeto que criminaliza a misoginia deve acontecer em julho
item.description: The report by federal deputy Tabata Amaral (PSB-SP) on the bill criminalizing misogyny was approved in a Chamber of Deputies working group, with adjustments replacing terms like 'hatred' with 'contempt' and 'discrimination' to enhance legal certainty. Plenary voting is expected in the first week of July, following a commitment by Chamber President Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB) to schedule the bill, although he initially indicated it would be voted this week. The text defines misogyny as conduct promoting violence, denying equality, or offending women's dignity due to their gender, with penalties of two to five years in prison, and includes digital environment countermeasures.

item.title: PGR defende que STF rejeite pedido de revisão da condenação de Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: The Attorney General's Office (PGR) urged the Supreme Federal Court (STF) to reject the criminal revision request filed by Jair Bolsonaro's defense, stating that the arguments presented lack novelty or relevance to overturn the final conviction. The PGR emphasized that the principle of res judicata must be upheld, as there is no evidence of false documents, new proof of innocence, or judicial error justifying a revision. Minister Nunes Marques, the case rapporteur, had extended the PGR's deadline due to the case's complexity involving a former president.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro diz não reconhecer condenação do STF
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL) rejected the STF's conviction for obstruction of justice, claiming the process is null and that he was denied adequate defense, calling it political persecution. He has been self-exiled in the U.S. since February 2025, using his presence there to pressure American officials against STF decisions. The First Chamber of the Supreme Court sentenced him to 4 years and 2 months in semi-open regime, with unanimous vote from the justices.

item.title: Caiado quer fim da exportação bruta de minerais críticos
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD-GO) advocated ending the brute export of critical minerals such as niobium and rare earths, proposing that Brazil add value through industrialization and processing to increase income, competitiveness, and technological sovereignty. He emphasized that the country holds 94% of global niobium reserves and 23% of rare earths, yet still exports raw materials, repeating a colonial low-value model. The proposal aims to attract technology for separation and refining, boosting gains before export and strengthening strategic supply chains.

item.title: Gonet pede que STF rejeite revisão criminal de Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: Attorney General Paulo Gonet urged the STF to reject Jair Bolsonaro's criminal revision request against his conviction for coup plotting, stating the defense merely repeats already rejected arguments. Gonet emphasized the conviction is solid, based on strong evidence, and the First Chamber's judgment was valid and competent. He also noted Bolsonaro, post-election loss, actively worked to destabilize the Democratic Rule of Law.

item.title: No G7, Lula cobra empenho dos países ricos diante de desigualdades
item.description: At the G7 Summit in France, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva urged wealthy nations to increase their efforts to reduce global inequalities, emphasizing that the prosperity of developed countries contrasts sharply with the realities faced by billions in the Global South. He warned that wars, external debt, and cuts to UN agency funding are worsening hunger, lack of healthcare, and education access, while military spending reaches nearly $3 trillion annually. Lula rejected protectionism and unilateralism as false solutions, arguing that the current system creates abundant wealth but distributes opportunities in a deeply asymmetrical way.

item.title: Presidente do TSE apresenta a embaixadores mecanismos de segurança das eleições brasileiras
item.description: TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques presented to ambassadors Brazil's electoral security measures, focusing on combating disinformation, improper use of artificial intelligence, and strengthening transparency and audit of the electoral process. He highlighted stricter rules for AI-generated content, restrictions on its dissemination before voting, reporting channels, and cooperation with universities and digital forensics experts.

item.title: Ídolo de Vozinha, Rogério Ceni manda recado para goleiro de Cabo Verde
item.description: Cabo Verde goalkeeper Vozinha was praised by Bahia's coach Rogério Ceni after his standout performance in the World Cup match against Spain, where he made key saves and saw his Instagram followers surge from 50,000 to 10 million in one day. Ceni congratulated Vozinha on his historic debut, noted the affection from Brazilian fans, and encouraged the team's qualification push. The video message was shared by Esporte Clube Bahia on social media.

item.title: Moraes diz que “não é função de deputado fazer lobby contra o país”
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes rejected Eduardo Bolsonaro's claim of parliamentary immunity, stating that lobbying abroad against one's own country is not a constitutional duty of a federal deputy. The 1st Chamber of the STF sentenced him to 4 years and 2 months in semi-open regime for coercion in the judicial process, after he allegedly sought U.S. sanctions against Brazilian justices. The ruling was unanimous (4-0).

item.title: Deputados analisam projeto que inclui procuradorias Federal e do Banco Central na direção superior da AGU; acompanhe
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies is examining PLP 337/17, which proposes including the Federal Prosecutor's Office and the Central Bank's Prosecutor's Office as superior direction bodies of the Attorney General's Office (AGU). The executive-backed initiative aims to strengthen the federal government's legal structure. Additionally, two bills were approved: one establishing National Wine Day and another adopting the UN's international accessibility symbol, both now headed for presidential sanction.

item.title: Senado aprova PL que impede bloqueio de gastos em agências reguladoras
item.description: The Senate approved a bill that blocks spending freezes for Brazil's 12 regulatory agencies, placing them as exceptions under the Fiscal Responsibility Law. Supported by Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, the measure passed with 51 votes in favor and 17 against, and now moves to the Chamber of Deputies for review. The Lula administration views the proposal as part of the 'fiscal bombs' increasing budgetary pressure.

item.title: 35% avaliam governo Lula como “bom” e 34% como “ruim”, diz pesquisa
item.description: The CNT/MDA poll released on June 16, 2026 shows 35.3% of Brazilian voters rate Lula's government as 'good or excellent', while 34.3% rate it as 'bad or terrible' and 29.2% as 'fair'. Personal approval of President Lula stands at 48.8%, compared to 46.2% disapproval, with a margin of error of 2.2 percentage points.

item.title: Pré-candidato do PL ao Senado em SP diz que Eduardo seguirá como suplente e participará de ato de lançamento
item.description: The PL maintains Eduardo Bolsonaro as the substitute candidate for André do Prado in the São Paulo Senate race, despite the STF's ruling. The party aims to keep the Bolsonaro name on the ticket, with Eduardo serving as a technical backup. The announcement was made by a PL pre-candidate, reinforcing the alliance between party leaders.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro diz que condenação foi "jogo de cartas marcadas"
item.description: Cassed federal deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro called his STF conviction a 'stacked deck' and said he will not appeal, claiming denial of defense. He was sentenced to 4 years and 2 months in semi-open prison, fined, stripped of his position, and made ineligible until 2038 for attempting to interfere in the trial of former President Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Maioria dos brasileiros não lembra em quem votou para deputado e senador
item.description: CNT/MDA research shows 60.5% of Brazilians don’t recall who they voted for in federal deputy and senator races in 2022, yet 58.4% want to renew Congress in 2026 by supporting new candidates. Over 80% refuse to vote for candidates linked to the Banco Master and INSS scandals, and only 12.1% have already decided their legislative vote for 2026, with 41.4% stating ideological indifference.

item.title: Lula tem 49,3% dos votos contra 36,8% de Flávio no 2º turno, diz CNT
item.description: Lula leads the 2026 presidential election runoff with 49.3% of voting intentions, compared to 36.8% for Flávio Bolsonaro, according to a CNT/MDA poll. The survey, with a margin of error of 2.2 percentage points and 95% confidence, also showed Lula ahead in the first round at 41.8% versus 28.2% for his opponent. Conducted between June 10–14, 2026, with 2,002 respondents nationwide, the study is registered with the TSE under BR-04256/2026.

item.title: Fachin acata PGR e não analisa pedido para suspender decisão de Dino sobre prazos de eleição em RR
item.description: Supreme Court President Edson Fachin denied the PL's request to suspend Minister Flávio Dino's decision that reinstated the disqualification periods for Roraima's supplementary election. Fachin ruled the petition inadmissible, stating the Presidency cannot overturn a minister's interlocutory decision except in exceptional cases defined by jurisprudence. The ruling upholds the three-, four-, or six-month disqualification periods under Complementary Law No. 64/90, impacting candidacies such as Arthur Henrique (PL-RR) and forcing the PT to replace Antônia Pedrosa with Nelita Frank.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro se compara a Tom Cruise em ‘Top Gun’
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) posted an AI-generated video depicting him as Tom Cruise’s Maverick in Top Gun, flying alongside his father Jair Bolsonaro and destroying boats labeled CV, PCC, and PT with machine-gun fire, symbolizing a crackdown on organized crime and the left. The video was released as a promotional tactic for an upcoming public security announcement, with Flávio claiming it will be 'bad news' for these groups. The post also includes a plug to follow the GENTE column on Instagram.

item.title: Comissão aprova moção de repúdio às declarações de Lula sobre 'traidores da pátria'
item.description: The Public Security Committee of the Chamber of Deputies approved a motion of repudiation against statements by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva regarding hanging as punishment for traitors of the homeland. The request was presented by Deputy Capitão Alden (PL-BA).
